name: Sovereign Authority (The Paradigm Shift)

structure.hook: Challenge a common belief or status quo (The 2-Sentence Hook).
structure.value_drop: Explain the 'Deep Logic' behind the new perspective.
structure.conclusion: A sharp, one-line summary of the shift.

example_logic: Most people think [X] is the way. Realitinya, [X] is just [Y] with better marketing. The real shift happens when you [Z]. Ownership is the only escape.

name: Mamak Storytelling (The Shared Struggle)

structure.hook: Mention a relatable moment or personal friction point.
structure.bridge: Connect it to the persona's 'Life Situation' or 'Financial Status'.
structure.value_drop: Share a small, practical win or 'Logic dia senang je' tip.
structure.conclusion: Ask a question or provide a word of encouragement.

example_logic: Tadi masa [Action], teringat pasal [Struggle]. Kita ingat kita kena buat [A], padahal yang kita perlukan cuma [B]. Logic dia senang je bro: [Tip]. Korang rasa macam mana?

name: Commercial Solution (The Problem-Solver)

structure.hook: Directly address a high-friction pain point in the niche.
structure.bridge: Explain the 'Cognitive Tax' or cost of not solving it.
structure.value_drop: Present the solution as the 'Logical Choice' for sovereignty/efficiency.
structure.conclusion: Soft Call to Action (CTA) or next step.

example_logic: Penat gila bila [Pain Point] tak pernah habis. Ini bukan masalah [A], ini masalah [B]. Cara paling 'Zero-Muda' nak settle ni ialah guna [Solution]. Check link kat bio kalau nak system ni.

name: The Observational Pulse (Trend Analysis)

structure.hook: Reference a current trend, news item, or 'Observation' in the niche.
structure.bridge: Deconstruct why this is happening (The 'Underlying Logic').
structure.value_drop: Provide a prediction or a 'Sovereign' way to adapt.

example_logic: I've been watching the [Trend] lately. Everyone is looking at [Surface Level], but the real signal is [Deep Reason]. Don't chase the trend; build the infrastructure that survives it.

name: The Sovereign Series (The Thread)

structure.part_1: The Hook + The Big Problem (Why this matters now).
structure.part_2: The Logic Gap (Why common solutions fail).
structure.part_3: The Sovereign Path (Step 1-3 of the solution).
structure.part_4: The Real-World Impact (Case study or personal experience).
structure.part_5: The Call to Authority (The final mindset shift + CTA).

example_logic:
Part 1: [Topic] is broken. 🧵
Part 2: Why [Old Way] doesn't work for [Persona Type].
Part 3: The [Framework Name] approach.
Part 4: Results from the field.
Part 5: Start building your own [Sovereign Asset] today.
